answer: The canyon index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 864 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the violet. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the crystal queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. A 445 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
